description: T-2705: does a scientific code with one integer placeholder round the exact double or its 15-digit decimal? A1:A6 and A12 are doubles just below a decimal tie, where the two readings differ (the exact double rounds down, the 15-digit decimal half away rounds up). A7, A8, A10, A11 and A14 are controls, and A9 is the fixed code `0.00` on 1.005.
